learning_objective: 🎯 Discover what Social Science is, explore its different branches, and understand why studying society is crucial for our daily lives!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Social Science is the scientific study of human society and social relationships. It helps us understand how people behave, interact, and organize themselves.

It acts as an umbrella holding various subjects: History (past events), Geography (earth and environments), Political Science (government and laws), Economics (wealth and resources), and Sociology (human interactions).
No branch works alone. For example, a country's geography (rivers, mountains) directly impacts its economy (trade) and history (invasions). They are all interconnected.
Just like physics or chemistry, social science relies on observation, data collection, and analysis to draw conclusions about human behavior and societal trends.
It turns us into informed citizens, helps us understand our rights and duties, solves societal problems like poverty, and promotes global peace and understanding.

fun_activity.title: 🔍 The Social Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Pick an object in your room, like a cotton T-shirt. Think about its Geography (where did the cotton grow?), History (who invented weaving?), and Economics (how much did it cost and who made it?). Write down one fact for each!

exam_tips: 📌 Always give examples when explaining the branches of social science. Example: Economics studies budgets, Geography studies climate.
📌 Understand the concept of 'Interdisciplinary Approach'—it means combining different subjects to get a complete picture of a problem.
📌 Questions often ask how Social Science helps in building a better society. Focus on awareness, problem-solving, and citizenship.
quick_recap: ⭐ Social science focuses on human beings and their social environment.
⭐ History tells us 'when' and 'how', while Geography tells us 'where'.
⭐ Studying social science makes us critical thinkers and responsible global citizens.
